rollback_evidence: G144 J29. Key pool@host. A host reservation of an existing pool: MAC address and an IPv4 address inside the pool network. The Junos commit confirmed safeguard protects the change and the inverse restores the exact configured attributes (G144). The write account reads the object back from the scoped configuration; the read-only account cannot read the configuration and no operational view lists an address-assignment pool or a relay group.
